stem:
Charu eats bran-rich roti and drinks a glass of water with lunch. She knows vitamins and minerals are nutrients. She asks about roughage and water.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Roughage does not supply nutrients but is still needed in the diet.
Water helps the body absorb nutrients and remove waste.
Roughage carries waste out of the body through sweat and urine.
One sip of water with lunch is enough for absorbing nutrients and removing waste.

teacher.key_rationale: Roughage is essential though it is not a nutrient. Water helps absorb nutrients and remove waste. Roughage does not remove waste through sweat and urine; one sip of water is not enough.
